question.problem: Calculate the volume of the parallelepiped spanned by $a=⟨-1,2,5⟩$, $b=⟨1,-4,2⟩$ and $c=⟨0,5,1⟩.$
question.worked_solution:
The volume of the parallelepiped spanned by three vectors is given by the absolute value of their triple product.

First, we compute the triple product:

$$
\begin{aligned}a\cdot (b\times c) & =|\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 & 5 \\ 1 & -4 & 2 \\ 0 & 5 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =(-1)\cdot |\begin{aligned}-4 & 2 \\ 5 & 1\end{aligned}|-2\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}|+5\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & -4 \\ 0 & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =-((-4)\cdot 1-5\cdot 2)-2(1\cdot 1-0\cdot 2)+5(1\cdot 5-0\cdot (-4)) \\  & =14-2+25 \\  & =37\end{aligned}
$$

    

Finally, we take the absolute value. So the volume of the corresponding parallelepiped is

$$
V=|37|=37.
$$
